look_here_first: Inspect the yellow flower head and sticky involucral bracts (phyllaries), then the stems: yellow ray florets surround a disk; many phyllary tips hook or curve back; stems are noticeably hairy/glandular. Check serrate leaves clasping the stem.

key_traits.label: Life cycle
key_traits.text: Herbaceous gumweed; confirm longevity on mature plants rather than relying on habit alone.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: Yellow ray florets present around yellow disk florets (radiate head).; Numerous phyllaries with hooked/recurved resinous tips.; Stems visibly hairy or glandular-hairy, especially toward the heads.; Alternate serrate leaves with sessile/clasping bases.; Sticky/resinous head, characteristic of Grindelia.

lookalikes.differences: Versus G. ciliata, compare stem pubescence (adenodonta hairier; ciliata usually otherwise glabrous/gland-dotted), annual habit, and mature pappus. G. nuda is typically rayless; do not infer a radiate specimen is nuda. G. squarrosa has strongly squarrose recurved phyllaries, but historical var. nuda records belong to a different current taxon. G. lanceolata has narrower leaves; use a mature head and stem together.
